messages:
Asha: Quick sync — nightly bench sweep shows skew: tiny models consume most deep benches, large models barely get scheduled. This is impacting coverage for high-impact models.
Ravi: I think FIFO + short runtime jobs bias the scheduler. small-model benches complete faster so they re-enter queue and dominate.
Katerina: Two levers: per-model replenishing safety tokens, and a weighted scheduler where weight = importance / recent_runs. Safety tokens guarantee golden checks.
Liam: Split lanes: safety (guaranteed, golden prompts) vs opportunistic (perf, heavy). Safety must be reserved even during cluster stress.
Asha: Proposal: safety_quota per model (e.g. 1 safety bench per 6h) + opportunistic pool. Unused safety tokens loan to opportunistic for N hours with audit trail.
Ravi: Intake should emit signed bench_ticket: `ticket_id, lane_assigned, scheduled_at, cost_estimate, model_bucket`. Workers verify signature and lane. Private deploys use local signing key.
Katerina: Observability: add `ticket_id` and `lane` to traces, export per-model backlog and avg wait. Console should show fairness heatmap.
Liam: Billing: tag bench runs with customer_id/team_tag and surface bench_cost in Dedicated invoices. Allow contract-level bench_quota overrides.
Asha: Edge case: meltdown mode — if cluster errors > 2% or p95 > 2x, suspend opportunistic benches, keep safety benches only. Add emergency_flag for customers to bypass in contracts.
Ravi: Simple policy pseudocode:
```
if cluster_degraded:
  opportunistic_rate = 0
  allow_safety_only()
else:
  schedule_weighted_fair()
```
Katerina: Also add a short preemption path: if a safety bench detects a large regression (delta > thresh), it can preempt the next opportunistic job and escalate. Preemptions are limited and audited.
bench-bot: queued TKT-171771-07 model:gpt-large lane:safety eta:1717712580 :gear:
Liam: Next steps: Ravi prototypes signed ticket flow, Katerina adds metrics to console, Asha will draft default fairness config and escalation thresholds. We'll follow up with an RFC addendum.
Asha: Thanks — want to avoid another bias weekend. :coffee:
